_comment: Response flavoring v1. leadIns/signOffs are one-sentence wraps appended before/after a fact. responseWraps are two-line shells (before + after) that bracket the fact. Slots: {ADJ}, {ADV}, {NOUN:theme}, {VERB:theme}, {ADJ:theme} — same syntax as templates.json. tone array can be [] for any-tone.
